extensions.name: Card Timer
extensions.summary: Use an optional target countdown during review without automatic grading.
extensions.description: Shows a configurable target timer beside each review card. Reaching zero only announces that the target elapsed; it never reveals, grades, or reschedules a card. The extension has no content or network access, and stores only its enabled state and duration in synchronized configuration.

extensions.name: Image Occlusion
extensions.summary: Create one recall prompt for each region you mask on an image.
extensions.description: Adds an accessible image-mask authoring panel and image-occlusion prompt renderer. Images stay in the local workspace; the extension has no network access. It can define prompt types and contribute an isolated panel to the authoring screen.

extensions.name: Memory Insights
extensions.summary: Inspect current collection workload and organization without mastery claims.
extensions.description: Provides read-only collection metrics, deck counts, common tags, due-today context, and content-health signals in a sandboxed page. Metrics describe the current collection and do not claim to measure mastery. The extension has no write or network access.

extensions.name: Anki & CSV Interoperability
extensions.summary: Preflight, import, and export Anki packages and CSV through rollback-safe migrations.
extensions.description: Inspects Anki .apkg and .colpkg files or CSV before committing, reports migration fidelity, and exports the current workspace to Anki or CSV. Imports use Neo Anki's migration broker, which creates a recovery checkpoint before any accepted commit. Files and workspace content are processed locally with no network access.

extensions.name: Prompt Types
extensions.summary: Add reverse, cloze, typed-answer, and audio study prompts.
extensions.description: Provides optional prompt creation, rendering, and typed-answer comparison for reverse, cloze, typed-answer, and audio cards. It receives only the knowledge item and card currently being created or reviewed, and has no content-wide, configuration, migration, or network access.

extensions.name: Recovery Policies
extensions.summary: Choose oldest-overdue or quick-wins ordering when a review backlog grows.
extensions.description: Adds two bounded queue-scoring strategies: oldest overdue first and quick wins first. It receives only scoped card scheduling candidates during planning, cannot write content or settings, and has no network access.

extensions.name: Shared Packs
extensions.summary: Install versioned learning packs as extension-owned content with provenance.
extensions.description: Validates Neo Anki pack files, installs their notes and provenance atomically, and applies later versions with field-level three-way merges. Conflicting local edits and scheduling-sensitive changes are preserved for explicit review; the extension has no network access and cannot modify content outside its reserved namespace.

extensions.name: NeoAnki TTS
extensions.summary: Generate, cache, and play provider-backed text-to-speech audio while studying in NeoAnki.
extensions.description: Generate and cache review audio with configurable profiles, batch processing, and live playback. Supports OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Google Cloud Text-to-Speech, and Azure Speech. Prompt text is sent directly to the provider you select; API credentials stay in the operating system's secure credential storage and are not synchronized. Provider accounts and usage charges may apply.

extensions.name: Goals & Saved Views
extensions.summary: Add learning goals, bounded planning signals, and reusable Library searches.
extensions.description: Adds an isolated workspace panel for learning goals and saved Library views. Goal matches contribute bounded priority signals to planning. Goals and views are kept in extension-owned synchronized configuration; the extension cannot write learning content or access the network.
